name: Riot

text.trigger: A player has a survivor at the colony and helpless survivors outnumber the other survivors there.
text.vignette: The pantry is locked and the crowd outside it grows louder, since there are more of them than there are in charge. Someone has found a crowbar and no one is willing to stand in front of it.

options.empty-the-pantry: Let them take it all: every food token is removed from the supply.
options.let-it-turn-ugly: Brawl in the hall: each survivor at the colony (helpless tokens excepted) takes 1 wound.
options.make-an-example: Make an example of one rioter: a helpless survivor dies (morale falls by 1).

notes: src: Crossroad_cards_v1.1.xlsx.txt card #49; Three options. Helpless tokens are not survivors: the wound goes on the survivors standing at the colony.
